'''Skeleton knight''' is a [[monster]] encountered during [[Ancient Awakening]] and in the standard and hard modes of the [[Ungael combat activity]].

During Ancient Awakening their [[life points]] are reduced to 70% of the value seen in the standard mode of Ungael combat activity. Two of them ambush the player and their expedition party when they first arrive on [[Ungael]], along with six [[zombie warrior]]s. They are later fought in the tower during the quest, where one of them appears in the first wave, one in the second wave, one in the fifth wave, one in the ninth wave, two in the tenth wave, and two in the eleventh wave, along with many other monsters.

In the standard mode of the Ungael combat activity one of them appears in each wave, except for the third and twelfth waves where they don't appear, and in the seventh wave where two appear, along with many other monsters.

In the hard mode of the Ungael combat activity their life points are increased to 150% of the value seen in the standard mode of Ungael combat activity. One of them appears in the first wave, two in second and third, one in fourth, two in fifth, one in sixth, two in seventh, and one in the eighth, ninth, and twelfth, along with many other monsters.
